scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.speaker: Rose
scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.text: hara do mangrove , bukon eang it para sa bisita kundi para protektahan.
scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.translation: This is the mangrove eco-park. It’s not just for visitors, but truly for conservation.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.speaker: Player
scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.text: It looks peaceful. I didn’t expect it to be this wide.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.speaker: Manong Ambo
scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.text: Mayad-ayad nga agahon , mga bisita. iya kamo para makita do aton nga mangroves?
scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.translation: Good morning, visitors. Are you here to see our coast and mangroves?

scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.speaker: Rose
scene_1_arrival_at_the_eco_park.text: Yes, Anong Ambo. He’s the caretaker here.

scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.speaker: Anong Ambo
scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.text: ro mga ugat ru gakapyot sa eugta. kaya indi masamad bisan it bagyo.
scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.translation: The roots hold the soil. It won’t collapse even during storms.

scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.speaker: Anong Ambo
scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.text: hara gid. Kung uwa ra, ro baeas ag tubi hay magatao it kaeainan
scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.translation: Exactly. Without this, the sand and water would cause danger.

scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.speaker: Rose
scene_2_learning_about_mangroves.text: That’s why they say mangroves are natural shields.

scene_3_fishing_lesson.speaker: Anong Ambo
scene_3_fishing_lesson.text: Gusto ninyo magkantoguhan magpamunit? bukon eang para sa isda, kundi para sa pagtuon.
scene_3_fishing_lesson.translation: Do you want to try fishing? Not just for fish, but for learning.

choices.label: Yes, I want to learn how.
Maybe later, I just want to watch first.
I’m not really into fishing, sorry.

scene_3_fishing_lesson.speaker: Rose
scene_3_fishing_lesson.text: You’ll miss out. It’s part of the experience, balikbayan.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.text: Tan-awa ru baybay — that’s “shore.” Tubi — water. eugta — soil. Baeas — sand.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.text: Maisog — brave. Maeuya — weak. Malimpyo — clean. Mahigko — dirty.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.text: tikang pa — keep walking. Pamati — listen. Pamunit — to fish. Tanom — plant.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.text: Okay, so pamunit is what Anong Ambo said earlier.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_nature.text: Correct. And tanom — you’ll hear that a lot here, since mangroves are plants.

scene_5_reflection.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_5_reflection.text: maabo aton nga natun-an makarang adlaw. bukon eang it mga haeambaeun, kundi pati kultura man.
scene_5_reflection.translation: We learned so much today. Not just words, but culture too.

scene_5_reflection.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_5_reflection.text: True. This place reminds me of my childhood.

scene_5_reflection.speaker: Rose
scene_5_reflection.text: And now it’s part of yours, balikbayan.

idle_pool_manong_ambo.speaker: Manong Ambo
idle_pool_manong_ambo.text: Ang dagat, indi siya kaaway. Kaibahan siya, kung tama ang pagtratar mo.
Hinahaplos ni Manong Ambo ang gilid ng bangka, tila kaibigan niya ito.

idle_pool_manong_ambo.speaker: Manong Ambo
idle_pool_manong_ambo.text: Damo turista nagapunta diri para lang sa litrato. Ikaw lain, nakikinig ka.

idle_pool_manong_ambo.speaker: Manong Ambo
idle_pool_manong_ambo.text: Ang mga bakhaw ni, indi lang para sa amon. Para man 'to sa isda, sa kalapati, sa tanan.
Tumingin si Manong Ambo sa malayo, mukhang naaalala ang panahong wasak pa ang lugar.

idle_pool_manong_ambo.speaker: Manong Ambo
idle_pool_manong_ambo.text: Kung may tyempo ka pa, balik ka diri kung early morning. Lain gid ang ganda kung aga.

idle_pool_manong_ambo.speaker: Manong Ambo
idle_pool_manong_ambo.text: Ang lugar nga malapit sa amon dagat, damo bisita gapunta. Pero diri, gusto lang namon hilway.
idle_pool_manong_ambo.translation: The place near our sea, many visitors go there. But here, we just want peace. [NEW-VERIFY: soft reference to Boracay tourism contrast, phrase draft]

idle_pool_manong_ambo.speaker: Manong Ambo
idle_pool_manong_ambo.text: Halong ka pirme sa dagat, apo. Ganda niya, pero indi siya laro.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag mo akong tignan nang ganyan, hindi ako tour guide. ...okay, konti lang.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka gid, ha. Indi lang basta-basta.
Tumingin si Rose sa Player nang matagal, parang sinusukat kung seryoso ba talaga siya.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: My Lola Susan talks about your Lola Jonabel parang superhero pa. Big shoes to fill, balikbayan.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Fine, you're not completely hopeless. ...don't let that get to your head.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Alam mo, hindi ko rin naman gustong magturo dati. Pero, sige na nga.
Napailing si Rose, pero halatang pigil ang ngiti.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag kang mag-expect ng slack sa 'kin kasi pinsan ka daw ni Tita Susan. Rules apply to everyone.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Stop overthinking the pronunciation. Just say it. Worst case, I laugh at you.
Tumingin si Rose sa mapa, tapos kay Player, parang sinusukat ang route.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Manong Pedring likes you. That's rare — he's picky about balikbayans.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magbulig ako sa imo, pero indi ako mangin madali. Deal pa rin 'yun.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're actually trying. Didn't expect that, not gonna lie.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: I actually like it here. Don't tell Manang Loleng I said that, she'll never let me hear the end of it.
Tinitignan ni Rose ang unang linya ng weaving ni Player, tapos tumango, medyo impressed.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're better at this than the greeting stuff, honestly. Weird flex, but okay.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka pa sang isara ka leksyon, tapos indi ka na "balikbayan" sa akon. Promise.
Nag-iisa si Rose sa dulo ng bangka, tinitignan ang tubig nang tahimik.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Manong Ambo's basically family. He used to carry me on his shoulders here, ages ago.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: This place calms me down. Don't get used to seeing me like this though.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Grabe 'to, parang bata ulit ako pag nandito. Sobrang dami ng memories, anak.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Huwag kang mag-alala kay Rose, ganyan talaga siya. Marunong naman siya magturo, promise.
Kinukuha ni Papa Jobert ang kanyang phone, kunwari kukuha ng litrato pero halatang nostalgic lang.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Alam mo, dito rin ako natutong mag-Akeanon dati. Parang paulit-ulit lang 'yung kwento, ha.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sabihin mo kay Lola kung kailan ka na-tire. Alam mo naman siya, hindi siya titigil sa excitement.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sobrang saya ni Lola ngayon, no? Sulit lahat ng jetlag para diyan.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Kung may makalimutan tayo, ako na bahala. Ikaw, focus ka lang sa pag-aaral.
Napapatango-tango si Papa Jobert habang naglalakad, parang bawat kanto may kwento.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Grabe, ang linis ngayon kumpara noon. Manong Ambo really did something here.
Kinunan ni Papa Jobert ng litrato ang paglubog ng araw, tahimik na tahimik.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sabi ni Lola dati, mas maganda raw dito kaysa kahit saan. Mukhang tama siya.
